skill: Mathematical symbols 数学符号
stem: 记号 $f'(x)$ 在中文教材中读作
explanation: 撇号表示求导，$f'(x)$ 读作「$f$ 撇 $x$」或「$f$ 对 $x$ 的导数」，几何意义是曲线在该点切线的斜率。

distractorRationale.B: 倒数写作 $\dfrac{1}{f(x)}$；「倒数」与「导数」读音相近而含义完全不同。

en.stem: In Chinese textbooks, how is the notation $f'(x)$ read?
en.explanation: The prime denotes differentiation; $f'(x)$ is read 「$f$ 撇 $x$」 or 「$f$ 对 $x$ 的导数」, and geometrically it is the slope of the tangent to the curve at that point.

skill: Physics terminology 物理术语
stem: 物理中「位移」与「路程」的区别在于

choices.text: 位移是矢量，路程是标量
位移是标量，路程是矢量
位移只能为正，路程可以为负

explanation: 位移是从起点指向终点的有向线段，有大小也有方向；路程是实际经过的轨迹长度，只有大小。绕圈跑回原点时位移为零，路程却等于跑过的全程。

distractorRationale.C: 路程恒为非负，位移的分量则可正可负。
distractorRationale.D: 只有沿直线单向运动时两者大小才相等。

en.stem: In physics, the difference between 位移 (displacement) and 路程 (distance travelled) is that
en.explanation: Displacement is the directed segment from start to finish, with both magnitude and direction; distance travelled is the length of the actual path, with magnitude only. Running a loop back to the start gives zero displacement but a distance equal to the whole route.

skill: Chemistry terminology 化学术语
stem: 化学中「置换反应」的特征是

choices.text: 两种或多种物质生成一种物质
一种单质与一种化合物反应，生成另一种单质和另一种化合物
两种化合物互相交换成分
一种物质分解为两种或多种物质

explanation: 置换反应的通式是「单质 + 化合物 → 新单质 + 新化合物」，如 $\text{Zn} + \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 \rightarrow \text{ZnSO}_4 + \text{H}_2$。两侧各有一种单质是它最醒目的标志。

distractorRationale.C: 这是复分解反应的特征。

en.stem: What characterises a 置换反应 (displacement reaction) in chemistry?
en.explanation: The general form is «element + compound → new element + new compound», as in $\text{Zn} + \text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 \rightarrow \text{ZnSO}_4 + \text{H}_2$. Having one free element on each side is its most visible signature.

skill: Physics terminology 物理术语
stem: 「比热容」这一物理量描述的是

choices.text: 单位质量的物质温度升高 $1\ ℃$ 所需吸收的热量

explanation:
比热容是物质的固有属性，单位为 $\text{J}/(\text{kg}\cdot ℃)$。水的比热容很大，故升温慢、降温也慢，常用作冷却剂。

须注意：「热量」是过程量，物体并不「含有」热量，故 A 的说法在物理上就不成立。

distractorRationale.A: 温度是另一个物理量，与比热容无关。
distractorRationale.B: 热量是传递过程中的能量，不是物体贮存的量。
distractorRationale.D: 传热快慢由热导率描述。

en.stem: The physical quantity 比热容 (specific heat capacity) describes
en.explanation:
Specific heat capacity is an intrinsic property of a substance, measured in $\text{J}/(\text{kg}\cdot ℃)$. Water's is large, so it warms slowly and cools slowly, which is why it serves as a coolant.

Note that 热量 is a quantity of transfer: an object does not «contain» heat, so the option describing «the amount of heat an object contains» is not even physically well-formed.

skill: Data chart interpretation 图表解读
stem: 以 $1.0\ \text{A}$ 放电时，该电池大约能持续供电
explanation:
$1.0\ \text{A} = 1000\ \text{mA}$，对应容量为 $1750\ \text{mAh}$。时间 $= \dfrac{1750\ \text{mAh}}{1000\ \text{mA}} = 1.75$ 小时。

关键是把电流的单位统一为毫安，否则数量级会差一千倍。

distractorRationale.A: 用了 $0.2\ \text{A}$ 那一行的容量数字。
distractorRationale.B: 直接把毫安时当作小时，漏掉了除以电流这一步。
distractorRationale.C: 用了 $3.0\ \text{A}$ 那一行的容量数字。

en.stem: Discharging at $1.0\ \text{A}$, roughly how long can this battery supply power?
en.explanation:
$1.0\ \text{A} = 1000\ \text{mA}$, and the matching capacity is $1750\ \text{mAh}$. Time $= \dfrac{1750\ \text{mAh}}{1000\ \text{mA}} = 1.75$ hours.

The key step is converting the current to milliamps; otherwise the answer is off by a factor of a thousand.

choices.text: 避免用力过大戳破滤纸

skill: Data chart interpretation 图表解读

stimulus.content:
某地区四种能源在总发电量中所占比例如下：

| 能源 | 占比 |
|---|---|
| 煤电 | 46% |
| 水电 | 22% |
| 风电 | 18% |
| 太阳能 | 14% |

stem: 根据表中数据，风电与太阳能合计所占比例是
explanation:
风电占 $18\%$，太阳能占 $14\%$，两项相加得 $18\% + 14\% = 32\%$。

这里各行都是同一总量（总发电量）的百分比，因此可以直接相加；若各行的分母不同，就不能这样处理。

distractorRationale.A: 这是除煤电外三项之和。

en.stem: From the table, wind and solar together account for what share?
en.explanation:
Wind is $18\%$ and solar $14\%$, so together they are $18\% + 14\% = 32\%$.

The rows are percentages of the same total (all generation), which is why they may simply be added; had the rows had different denominators, this would not be valid.

发电量占比与装机容量并非一回事，因为不同能源的利用小时数差别很大。

distractorRationale.B: 表中完全没有成本信息。
distractorRationale.C: 表只有一个时点的数据，看不出逐年变化。
distractorRationale.D: 表中给的是发电量占比，不是装机容量，且水电占比更高。

en.stem: On the basis of this table alone, which statement holds?
en.explanation:
$22\% + 18\% + 14\% = 54\%$, which is indeed more than half. Each of the other options needs information the table does not contain: installed capacity, year-on-year figures, or costs.

Share of generation is not the same as installed capacity, since different sources run for very different numbers of hours.

skill: Technical passage comprehension 科技文理解

stimulus.content: 全球定位系统由分布在多条轨道上的卫星组成。接收机通过测量信号从卫星传到自身所用的时间，算出与各颗卫星的距离。理论上测得与三颗卫星的距离即可确定位置，但由于接收机内部时钟的精度远不及卫星上的原子钟，实际至少需要四颗卫星：第四颗用于修正接收机的时钟误差。

stem: 根据短文，实际定位至少需要四颗卫星，第四颗的作用是

choices.text: 修正接收机的时钟误差

explanation: 短文末句明确指出，第四颗卫星用于修正接收机时钟误差。因为距离由时间乘光速得出，微小的时钟误差就会造成很大的距离偏差。

distractorRationale.A: 备用不是短文给出的理由。
distractorRationale.C: 短文未把信号强度作为需要第四颗卫星的理由。
distractorRationale.D: 三颗卫星在理论上已能给出三维位置，海拔不需要额外一颗。

en.stem: According to the passage, what is the role of the fourth satellite in an actual position fix?
en.explanation: The final sentence says plainly that the fourth satellite corrects the receiver's clock error. Since distance is time multiplied by the speed of light, even a tiny clock error produces a large error in distance.

stem: 根据短文可以推知，若接收机也装上与卫星同级的原子钟，则

choices.text: 需要的卫星数将增加到五颗
理论上三颗卫星即可完成定位

explanation: 短文说需要第四颗卫星的唯一原因是接收机时钟不够精确。若这一缺陷被消除，就回到短文所说的理论情形：三颗卫星即可确定位置。

distractorRationale.A: 消除误差应减少而非增加所需卫星数。
distractorRationale.B: 时钟更精确只会使定位更容易。
distractorRationale.D: 距离仍须由卫星信号测得。

en.stem: From the passage, if a receiver carried an atomic clock as good as the satellites', then
en.explanation: The passage gives the receiver's imprecise clock as the sole reason a fourth satellite is needed. Remove that defect and the situation reverts to the theoretical case the passage describes: three satellites suffice.
